text: Could you draw a cartoon for me? I’ve had this little scene in my head for a while, and I’d love to see it brought to life. The character should be a little yellow robot, and the picture should be square. It should have one big round eye and purple boots. Please show it holding a red watering can beside a pot of seedlings.
